M1_audit_reproduce.evidence: 29/29 pre-existing tests pass; e2e loop exercised via TestClient and live uvicorn

M2_knowledge_tracing.evidence: 10 models evaluated on ASSISTments 2009 variant under student-level split; leakage probes pass; best AUC 0.748 (GRU-KT); 0.90 target honestly unmet and explained

M3_student_state.evidence: alpa/core/state.py; schema-versioned JSON roundtrip exact; deterministic transition tested; mastery/uncertainty separation tested

M4_concept_graph.evidence: alpa/core/graph.py; typed edges with provenance; unreviewed LLM edges excluded from traversal until reviewed; cycle detection; engine traverses via graph

M5_adaptive_policy_info_gain.evidence: Fisher-information tie-break in item selection; uncertainty-resolution branch; two measured defects fixed (misconception over-firing, remediation loop) with regression tests

M6_retention_spaced_retrieval.evidence: power-law retention + review scheduler in core/model.py; SPACED_REVIEW fires at R<0.60 (time-travel test); no wall-clock timestamps in ASSISTments variant => step-lag proxy only, labeled

M7_content_ingestion.evidence: TXT/MD/PDF/DOCX/PPTX extraction tested against real generated files incl. hand-built PDF; segmentation; provenance-stamped concept AND edge proposals; LLM edges non-traversable until /api/edges/{id}/approve; malformed/garbled/ambiguous provider outputs rejected by validation without crashing the pipeline

M8_llm_provider_abstraction.evidence: provider ABC + registry; deterministic TemplateProvider; HTTPChatProvider (OpenAI-compatible chat completions) validated over REAL TCP against a mock-compatible server: auth header, response_format negotiation, defensive JSON parsing, GenerationSpec embedded verbatim; UNVALIDATED against paid external endpoints (no keys in this environment)

M9_end_to_end_sessions.evidence: full loop runs without manual intervention incl. provider-generated teaching content; robust grading: MCQ by choice, numerical by tolerance, short answer by normalized match, external/rubric grading rejected from the core model; scripts/demo_llm_session.py demonstrates the complete flow live

M10_synthetic_evaluation.evidence: policy_eval.py: 4 policies x 7 planted profiles x 150 students; adaptive policy success 0.750 vs fixed 0.723, mastery parity; labeled NOT human evidence

M11_api_persistence_traceability.evidence: all Phase O endpoints plus /graph, /state, /ingest, /concepts/{id}/approve; interventions/{id}/trace joins policy+prediction+outcome

M12_testing_repro_docs.evidence: 54 tests incl. leakage probes, determinism, serialization, approval gate, edge cases; experiment registry append-only; datasets hashed; seeds pinned

M13_env_configured_free_provider.evidence: provider.register_from_env() registers an HTTPChatProvider from ALPA_LLM_BASE_URL/API_KEY/MODEL at app startup, tested (test_register_from_env_*); .env.example documents Groq/Google AI Studio/OpenRouter free tiers + local Ollama; /api/health reports live-provider status; UNVALIDATED against a real paid/free endpoint (no network egress or key in this environment) — same caveat as M8's HTTPChatProvider

M14_general_frontend_prototype.evidence: web/index.html: student can paste/upload arbitrary material or type topics, ingest -> auto-approve concepts+edges -> adaptive session in one flow, mid-session 'teach it something new' re-ingestion, provider-status badge; smoke-tested end-to-end via TestClient (ingest, approve, diagnostic decision, progress); auto-approve-everything is a deliberate prototype shortcut that removes the human-review gate M4/M7 were built around — fine for a single trusted pilot user, wrong for multi-tenant/public use (see known_limitations)

deferred.paid_llm_endpoints: HTTPChatProvider is wire-protocol validated against a mock OpenAI-compatible server; pointing it at a real paid endpoint requires an API key (env: base_url/api_key/model constructor args) and content-quality QA budget
deferred.irt_difficulty_refit: item b remains priors; offline refit from attempts is queued (Phase A finding 1)
deferred.bandit_upgrade: exploration logged since day one; gated on >=50-100k intervention records + off-policy evaluator
deferred.multi_kc_updates: only primary concept updated per attempt
deferred.structured_rubric_items: generated structured items are validated but kept out of the attempt pipeline: rubric/LLM grading must stay outside the core student model until separately instrumented and versioned
deferred.human_rct: the primary question (does adaptation improve human learning) requires the pre-registered RCT; no offline metric substitutes

known_limitations: SQLite default (Postgres later is a URL change)
non-MCQ generated items validated+graded at spec level but deferred from the attempt pipeline
ASSISTments variant lacks timestamps: retention analyses there are step-lag proxies only
synthetic results are algorithm checks, never human-learning evidence

frontend auto-approves all ingested concepts/edges with no human-review step — acceptable for a small trusted pilot (a few named students, one operator watching), not for public/self-serve signup: a bad or adversarial upload becomes teachable content immediately
single shared graph/course per DB: multiple students' uploaded material all lands in one concept graph; there is no per-student or per-class content namespace yet

free-tier LLM endpoints (Groq/Gemini/OpenRouter/Ollama) are wired via the existing OpenAI-compatible HTTPChatProvider but not live-tested against a real key in this environment — test locally before a pilot session
